lesson.name: Learn The Italian Game
lesson.description: The Italian Game has been a popular opening for centuries and it's still played at the highest level today. Learn the key ideas to play the Italian with either side.

and achieve a good game?} 5... O-O {[%wrong White wins material. Try again and
look for the best way to defend your f7-pawn.] [%hint Safeguard your king and

{White has chosen a bad moment to castle and Black can start a strong attack.
How should you do it?} 7... Nd4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find
a way to add more attackers against a pinned piece.] [%hint Add another
attacker against the pinned knight on f3.]} (7... Bxf3 $2 8. Qxf3 {White
recaptures with a good position. Try again and look for a way to build
pressure on the pinned knight before capturing it.}) (7... h6 $2 8. Bxf6 {
White will meet Qxf6 with Nd5 and take a slight initiative. Try again and look
for a way to target a pinned piece.}) (7... O-O $2 8. Nd5 {White will be the
first player to start exposing the opponent's king. Try again and look for a way
to target a pinned piece.}) 8. Nd5 {Good decision! White attempted to copy
Black's idea, but Black hasn't castled yet, so doubled pawns aren't an issue.
What should Black play?} c6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look
for a useful threat.] [%hint Chase White's knight from the center.]} (8...
Nxf3+ $5 {This is a good capture, but there's a threat that's even stronger.
Try to find it.}) (8... Bxf3 $2 9. gxf3 {Black is slightly better, but there's
a threat that's significantly stronger. Try to find it.}) (8... h6 $5 {This is
reasonable, but another threat is more useful. Try to find an even better way
to target a white piece.}) 9. Ne3 {Good idea! How should you expose the white
king?} Nxf3+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a good

Bxf3 $2 10. gxf3 {Black is only slightly better. Try again and look for a
better capture.}) (9... Bh5 $2 10. g4 {White breaks the pin on f3 with an OK

again and look for a more aggressive bishop move.}) (10... Be6 $2 11. Bxe6 {

look for a more aggressive bishop move.}) (10... Bc8 $2 11. Ng2 {Black is only
